profile.title: Rights-Ontology Controlled Humanitarian Deployment Example
profile.description: Non-operative example showing different rights for human, legal, storage, analysis, and audit agents over shared information.

rights_holder.licensing_capacity: Copyright owner or authorised licensor — verify
title_evidence: Rights register and contributor instruments — populate

creator_protection.ownership_and_authority: The identified creator and rights holder retains every interest not expressly granted and controls whether commercial or operational permission is offered, subject to verified title and mandatory law.

investments.description: Historical and current research, design, engineering, documentation, governance, testing, negotiation, and maintenance labour.
investments.valuation_method: Contemporaneous hours, professional replacement rates, comparable engagements, and evidenced commercial value.
investments.recovery_treatment: Relevant to negotiated price, agreed compensation, proven loss, settlement, and remedies available under law.

investments.description: LLM tokens, compute, storage, network, software, and technical services funded or supplied for development.
investments.valuation_method: Invoices, usage logs, replacement cost, and attributable infrastructure allocation.
investments.recovery_treatment: Included in investment and pricing evidence and claimed where the selected remedy permits.

investments.description: Humanitarian, privacy, security, transborder, ontology, licensing, and assurance work necessary for responsible deployment.
investments.valuation_method: Actual expenditure and professional replacement cost.
investments.recovery_treatment: Protected investment relevant to licence value, loss, response cost, and negotiated remedies.

creator_protection.ai_contribution_policy: Preserve human planning, prompts, source inputs, selections, corrections, integration, validation, and authorship evidence; provider terms must be reviewed and no model training, embedding, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval ingestion, or derivation permission is implied.

jurisdiction.governing_law: New South Wales, Australia — draft selection
jurisdiction.forum: Competent courts in New South Wales, without removing mandatory local remedies — review
relevant_regions: Each place of access, processing, effect, or affected-person presence

formation.offer: Complete negotiated deployment terms and every incorporated schedule.
formation.acceptance_action: Authorised signatures of identified parties with versioned artifact hashes.
formation.consideration: Negotiated reciprocal promises, controlled deployment permission, services, and payment — counsel to settle.

resources.name: Identified software release
resources.sensitivity: publicly inspectable source; controlled operational permission

resources.name: Participating person's private record
authority_sources: valid authority source per processing purpose

resources.name: Approved de-identified aggregate output
resources.sensitivity: release-controlled and subject to re-identification assessment

rights_relations.context: approved systems, locations, users, controls, and term
rights_relations.validity: Approved deployment term, subject to suspension and valid termination.

rights_relations.purpose: protect dignity, agency, confidentiality, and agreed participation
rights_relations.context: entire data value cycle and all locations
conditions: Consent is scoped and not the only possible legal basis
rights_relations.validity: According to each authority source; artifact-attached protections and accrued claims survive exit.

rights_relations.purpose: provide purpose-bound custody for the approved service
rights_relations.context: approved New Zealand environment and authorised support access
rights_relations.validity: During processing and through return, deletion, or legally required retention.

rights_relations.purpose: produce the defined humanitarian service aggregate
rights_relations.context: isolated approved computation with accountable operator review
rights_relations.validity: Single approved processing window; capability expires and is revocable.

rights_relations.context: during and after participation unless a valid external authority applies
conditions: Lawful compulsory process handled under the government-access procedure
rights_relations.validity: Travels with the record and derived artifacts according to the persistence rule.

rights_relations.context: processing whose authority source is withdrawable consent
conditions: Withdrawal does not erase past lawful processing or independent mandatory duties
Other asserted legal bases require separate review
rights_relations.validity: While the consent relation exists and according to applicable law.

rights_relations.action: respect grant boundaries, creator choice, attribution, material interests, investment, compensation, audit, and remedies
rights_relations.purpose: prevent the creator being compelled to subsidise or surrender control to an exploiter
rights_relations.context: all inspection, access, installation, operation, modification, AI use, disclosure, commercialisation, termination, and post-termination conduct
conditions: Excluded or unauthorised use receives no licence
rights_relations.validity: Throughout the grant and for every ownership, attribution, evidence, accrued-claim, confidentiality, audit, and remedy interest that survives.
evidence: Use, benefit, loss, impact and enforcement records

permitted_actions: permit bounded agent processing defined by the rights schedule
prohibited_actions: cause or facilitate a Prohibited Harm
grant.purpose: Operate the identified release solely for the negotiated humanitarian service and rights-governed information relations.
grant.termination: Material breach, safety suspension, expiry, or agreed event, with persistence of protected records, rights, evidence, and accrued claims.

data_governance.agreement_title: Rights-Governed Information and Transborder Processing Agreement
purposes: support participant rights and accountable audit
data_governance.collection_limitation: Collect only documented fields necessary for an approved purpose through lawful and fair means with required knowledge or consent.
data_governance.data_quality: Provide correction and downstream propagation appropriate to purpose, risk, and applicable law.
data_governance.use_limitation: No incompatible purpose, independent processor benefit, advertising, model training, re-identification, or onward disclosure without a separately valid authority source.
security_safeguards: Encryption in transit and at rest with reviewed key control
data_governance.openness: Publish intelligible information about accountable parties, categories, purposes, locations, recipients, retention, government access, rights, and remedies.
data_governance.individual_participation: Provide confirmation, access, correction, challenge, reasons, complaint, representation, and effective remedy subject to applicable law and protected third-party interests.
data_governance.retention_and_deletion: Use purpose- and law-specific periods; revoke access promptly on exit; preserve third-party-anchored, co-owned, evidentiary, and artifact-attached interests as validly required.

transfers.purpose: Encrypted purpose-bound storage and availability for the approved service
transfers.mechanism: [Applicable lawful transfer mechanism and version — counsel to replace]
transfers.onward_transfer: Prohibited without prior recorded authority, equivalent flow-down rights, updated assessment, and participant/regulator steps required by law.
transfers.continuing_protection: Importer accepts equivalent purpose, security, participation, audit, deletion, government-demand, and remedy duties.

government_access_assessment.legal_basis: Example-only destination-law assessment record — replace with current qualified review.
government_access_assessment.necessity_and_proportionality: Example-only assessment of scope, standards, minimisation, and challenge — replace.
government_access_assessment.oversight: Example-only identification of approval and independent oversight — replace.
government_access_assessment.transparency: Example-only notification and aggregate reporting analysis — replace.
government_access_assessment.redress: Example-only identification of complaint, court, and regulator mechanisms — replace.

transfers.suspension_trigger: Suspend new transfer when the mechanism, destination assessment, safeguards, or effective remedy ceases to provide required continuing protection.

technical_instruments.subject: deployment-operator
technical_instruments.cryptographic_suite: Implementation-selected verifiable credential and artifact hashes; security and legal review required.
technical_instruments.revocation: Rights-holder suspension/revocation endpoint plus human review and appeal.

technical_instruments.subject: storage-agent
technical_instruments.cryptographic_suite: Short-lived audience-bound capability with proof-of-possession; implementation review required.
technical_instruments.validity: Short-lived and rotated; no authority after revocation or expiry.
technical_instruments.revocation: Online status and immediate access-control denial with recorded reason and review.

technical_instruments.subject: analysis-agent
technical_instruments.cryptographic_suite: One-use audience- and purpose-bound capability; implementation review required.

technical_instruments.subject: deployment-operator
actions: record specific consent assertion and withdrawal
technical_instruments.purpose: Evidence one identified consent scope where consent is the selected valid authority source.
technical_instruments.cryptographic_suite: Signed consent receipt with privacy-preserving subject reference; implementation review required.
technical_instruments.validity: Scope- and time-bound; future use stops on effective withdrawal where consent is the basis.
technical_instruments.revocation: Authenticated withdrawal appends a superseding status and propagates to affected capabilities.

technical_instruments.subject: participating-person
actions: record protected rights and lifecycle events
technical_instruments.purpose: Tamper-evident evidence of authority, access, disclosure, correction, withdrawal, incident, and remedy events.
technical_instruments.cryptographic_suite: Permissioned append-only record of hashes and protected references; implementation review required.
technical_instruments.validity: Purpose- and law-specific retention with contested and superseded statuses.
technical_instruments.revocation: Access can be revoked; historical false assertions receive signed correction records.

ledger.technology: Technology-neutral permissioned append-only event record; production selection pending.
ledger.correction_strategy: Append signed correction, dispute, or superseding status; preserve provenance and restricted underlying evidence.
ledger.revocation_strategy: Append revocation effective time and deny future capability validation without erasing history.
ledger.key_compromise_process: Emergency suspend, mark compromised keys and derived credentials, rotate, re-verify, reissue, notify, investigate, and remediate.

enforcement.notice: Identify claimant, relation, authority, legal instrument, facts, evidence, effect, requested protection, and response route.
enforcement.cure: Allow proportionate cure unless incompatible with imminent safety, evidence, continuing harm, or law.
enforcement.urgent_protection: Suspend affected capabilities or transfers to prevent imminent harm, then provide prompt accountable review.
enforcement.appeal: Independent review with accessible participation, reasons, correction, restoration, and external remedies.
enforcement.evidence_preservation: Preserve rights statements, authority, terms, tokens, logs, notices, responses, impacts, costs, and provenance under protected access.
enforcement.affected_person_remedy: Prioritise safety, cessation, restoration, participation, remedy, and non-recurrence before financial allocation.
enforcement.creator_remedy: Restore the creator's control and material position through cessation, supported licence value, loss, investment, attributable-profit and enforcement-cost recovery; do not require the creator to subsidise a better-funded exploiter.
enforcement.non_licensee_notice: Unauthorised use does not create assent or a contractual debt; reserve applicable statutory relief and identify settlement offers accurately.

deterrence.objective: Protect creator autonomy and make deliberate, harmful, or gainful misuse economically unattractive without allowing payment to purchase Prohibited Harm.
protected_interests: Invested labour, compute, capital, opportunity, safety and compliance resources
evidence_required: Use, benefit, loss, impact, response cost, knowledge, concealment, recurrence and post-notice evidence
deterrence.contract_path: Use negotiated pricing, audit, indemnity, agreed compensation, suspension, termination, cost recovery and dispute terms under an accepted agreement.
deterrence.non_assenter_path: Use statutory and other non-contractual remedies, including injunction, damages, account of profits, additional damages and competent criminal or regulatory referral where the law applies; a later settlement remains voluntary.
deterrence.profit_recovery: Seek gain-based relief where available so the exploiter does not retain attributable profit, with required apportionment and non-duplication.
deterrence.creator_cost_recovery: Claim supported creator labour, compute, opportunity, investigation, preservation, professional, enforcement, funding, collection and remediation costs wherever recoverable.
deterrence.additional_damages_reservation: Reserve court-controlled additional or enhanced relief for relevant flagrancy, benefit, concealment, recurrence, vulnerability targeting, evidence destruction and post-notice conduct.

financial_remedies.trigger: A counsel-defined material breach or use outside the accepted deployment scope after accountable factual review.
financial_remedies.legitimate_interest: Protect creator choice, bargaining position, invested resources, affected persons, system integrity, enforceability, and the commercial value of authorised deployment.
creator_interest_components: Creator labour, compute and compliance investment
Investigation, containment, remediation and enforcement burden
Scale, duration, benefit, knowledge and recurrence
financial_remedies.valuation_method: Supported authorised-use value plus evidence-backed creator investment, response, remediation and enforcement components, adjusted for causation, legitimate interests, proportionality and duplicate recovery.
financial_remedies.proportionality_analysis: The amount protects interests extending beyond immediate out-of-pocket loss but must not be exorbitant or out of proportion under the governing law.
financial_remedies.amount_or_range: [Counsel-approved amount or range after evidence-based valuation — replace]
financial_remedies.causal_link: Include only components connected to the defined event or protected legitimate interests to the extent required by law.
financial_remedies.becomes_payable_when: The accepted contract, settlement, judgment, or applicable law makes the reviewed amount due.
financial_remedies.review_and_dispute: Notice, evidence, response, independent human review, correction, and competent dispute forum.

financial_remedies.trigger: Proven use outside the copyright grant or other conduct supporting gain-based relief.
financial_remedies.legitimate_interest: Prevent a licensee or non-licensee retaining attributable gains from unauthorised exploitation.
financial_remedies.valuation_method: Disclosure, audit, accounting, apportionment and avoided-cost evidence under applicable law.
financial_remedies.proportionality_analysis: Limit the claim to recoverable attributable gain and credit overlapping recovery where required.
financial_remedies.amount_or_range: Attributable profit or gain determined by settlement or competent order.
financial_remedies.causal_link: Benefit must be attributable under the governing test.
financial_remedies.cap: Recoverable attributable gain and any legal limit.
financial_remedies.becomes_payable_when: A settlement, judgment, order, or other legally sufficient event makes the amount due.
financial_remedies.review_and_dispute: Competent disclosure, accounting, human review, and adjudication.

financial_remedies.trigger: A defined breach causes reasonable protection, investigation, preservation, professional, enforcement, funding, collection, or remediation expenditure.
financial_remedies.legitimate_interest: Prevent the wrongdoer externalising the supported cost of making the creator's and affected persons' rights effective.
financial_remedies.valuation_method: Actual reasonable expenditure and evidenced creator time, subject to the accepted allocation rule and governing law.
financial_remedies.proportionality_analysis: Recover only supported, reasonable and legally recoverable costs, with review of caps and professional rules.
financial_remedies.causal_link: The defined breach must have caused or reasonably required the expenditure under the governing rule.
financial_remedies.cap: Applicable contractual, statutory, court-controlled, reasonableness, and professional-rule limits.
financial_remedies.becomes_payable_when: The accepted contract, settlement, judgment, costs order, or applicable law makes the amount due.
financial_remedies.review_and_dispute: Itemised notice, access to supporting evidence, human review, and agreed or competent dispute forum.

enforcement_funding.allocation: Separate reviewed agreements may allocate an agreed part of actual recoveries to counsel, funders, investigators, rights-management agents, or verified referral sources so enforcement is practically available.
safeguards: Creator retains informed control subject to professional duties and court supervision
No reward for accusation alone and no misrepresentation of disputed liability
All fees, uplift, commission, priorities, adverse-cost exposure and termination rights are transparent
Conflicts, privilege, confidentiality, funder influence and settlement authority are controlled

recovery_waterfall: Urgent protection and restoration for affected natural persons, including the creator
Creator/rightsholder restitution for lost use value, proven loss, impaired investment, diverted opportunity, and attributable gain
Reasonable protective, investigative, legal, enforcement, funding, collection, and remediation costs
Other adopted humanitarian project purposes after the preceding interests are satisfied
